entries.final_answer: Reach complete WordPerfect 5.1 DOS parity in M1, then add PDF export and selected modern conveniences in M2; preserve original native and companion formats in both missions.
entries.question: Should Wordling first reach complete WP 5.1 DOS parity, then add PDF export and selected modern conveniences, preserving original formats permanently?
entries.rationale: Lynn proposed the two-mission split, confirmed WP 5.1 and permanent file-format fidelity, and explicitly instructed creation of this charter and parity mission. Recorded from the existing conversation; no new answer inferred.
